title: 第13章 穿云谷落雪殒命第14章 遇先天战敌慕容
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
“老裴，你射术如此厉害，可会使剑？”
队伍不断的深入草原，裴礼身旁，瘦猴一直叨叨个不停。
裴礼回道：“还算凑合。”
“只是凑合？啊哈哈，那刀呢？”
“还算勉强。”
“一个凑合，一个勉强，那你更擅长哪个？”
“都会一点。”
“只会一点怎么能行，我传你一套刀法如何？！”
瘦猴好似英雄有了用武之地，一把抽出马背上的制式长刀，翻身下马耍了一套刀法。
刀法大开大合，犹如海浪，一浪高过一浪。
裴礼认出这是狂风刀法，何人所创不知道，不过打出此刀法名头的，是登州的狂风帮。
不过师父曾言，这个帮派在十几年前就被灭了。
再看瘦猴，裴礼对其的身份有了些许猜测。
不过这个都不重要。
谁都有一段不堪回首的往事。
人总得往前看，不能总活在过去。
裴礼一行人进入草原已经三日时间，算算脚程，距离乌兰山已经不远了。
乌兰山所在，有个贺兰部落。
虽说不属于漠北八部，但实力亦不可小觑。
毕竟草原人与中原人不同，皆是下马牧羊，上马便战。

近年来，贺兰部落吃定了镇北军不敢开战，缕缕犯境，抢完了就跑。
镇北军此次就是要拔除这颗钉子，也可借此敲打敲打草原其他部落。
而裴礼这支斥候小队的任务，就是替后方的云落城大军探路。
在大军进攻乌兰山时，还要游走配合。
“前面再有三十里就是穿云谷了，那里已经是进入贺兰部落的势力范围。”
老孙头看着视线尽头，询问是否需要绕路，毕竟从穿云谷通过，存在不小的风险。
齐安考虑到绕路会浪费不少时间，并且带的水已经不多，决定冒险走穿云谷。
约莫一个时辰后，一行人来到穿云谷外的丛林。
瘦猴去简单的探查了一下情况，得知里面有约莫百十来个北蛮子。
“吃掉他们，动作要快！”
齐安果断下令。
他们是飞鱼营精锐斥候，身上都有修为，寻常北蛮子根本不放在眼里。
裴礼在队伍最后，跟着他们一起冲了进去。
很快就与穿云谷内的北蛮子正面硬刚在一起。
齐安拥有后天境七层的实力，对付普通小兵犹如砍瓜切菜。
瘦猴与老孙头虽说是凡级境界，可也到了练筋层次。
content_en:
"Lao Pei, your shooting skills are so good, but how can you use a sword?"
The team continued to go deeper into the grassland, and beside Pei Li, the thin monkey kept chattering.
Pei Li replied: "It's not bad."
"Just making do? Haha, where's the knife?"
"Not too bad."
"One makes do, the other reluctantly, which one are you better at?"
"A little bit of both."
"How can you do it if you only know a little bit? How about I teach you a set of sword skills?!"
The thin monkey seemed to have a place for a hero. He pulled out the standard long knife on the horse, turned over and dismounted, and performed a set of sword skills.
The sword skills open and close like waves, one wave higher than the other.
Pei Li recognized that this was the Guangfeng Sword Technique. He didn't know who created it, but it was the Guangfeng Gang in Dengzhou who created the name of this sword technique.
However, Master once said that this gang was wiped out more than ten years ago.
Looking at the thin monkey again, Pei Li had some guesses about his identity.
But none of this matters.
Everyone has a past that is difficult to look back on.
People have to look forward and cannot always live in the past.
It had been three days since Pei Li and his party entered the grassland. Calculating their distance, they found that they were not far from Wulan Mountain.
Where Wulan Mountain is located, there is a Helan tribe.
Although they do not belong to the Eight Tribes of Mobei, their strength cannot be underestimated.
After all, the grassland people are different from the people in the Central Plains. They all herd sheep when they dismount, and they fight when they mount their horses.
In recent years, the Helan tribe was so convinced that the Zhenbei army did not dare to start a war. They violated the border and ran away after looting.
The Zhenbei Army wants to pull out this nail this time, and also use it to knock other tribes on the grassland.
The mission of Pei Li's scout team is to explore the way for the Yunluo City army behind them.
When the army attacked Wulan Mountain, they had to travel around to cooperate.
"Thirty miles ahead is Chuanyun Valley, which has already entered the sphere of influence of the Helan tribe."
Lao Suntou looked at the end of his sight and asked if he needed to take a detour. After all, there was a lot of risk in passing through Chuanyun Valley.
Qi'an considered that taking a detour would waste a lot of time, and he didn't bring much water, so he decided to risk walking through Yungu.
About an hour later, the group arrived at the forest outside Chuanyun Valley.
Shouhou went to briefly investigate the situation and learned that there were about a hundred northern barbarians inside.
"Eat them and be quick!"
Qi An gave the order decisively.
They were the elite scouts of Feiyu Camp, and they all had great abilities. The ordinary northern barbarians didn't take them seriously at all.
Pei Li was at the end of the team and rushed in with them.
Soon he was head-on with the Northern Barbarians in Chuanyun Valley.
Qi'an possesses the strength of the seventh level of Houtian Realm, and dealing with ordinary soldiers is like chopping melons and vegetables.
Although Shouhou and Lao Suntou are at the ordinary level, they have also reached the level of muscle training.
